_about: Complete tracked-artifact publication inventory for E1. One entry per tracked file or per explicitly enumerated file group. Answers, for every artifact: origin, raw/derived, whether it is needed for the promised reproduction, whether it carries participant- or source-level content, the disposition, and why. Nothing here grants or implies a right to redistribute SPL material.
paper: When State Becomes Information: Release-Conditioned Basketball Forecasting
